features.name: MCP stdio server
features.notes: 37 tools are declared and 36 register in the default generic profile; handoff_existing is deferred behind the promotion contract. Against a fresh generic coord.db, preflight, board, next_work, work_context, event_context, inbox, inbox_recent, runs, knowledge_search, facts_query, knowledge_index_status, the memory-proposal reads, and the claim/heartbeat/note/audit/decision/park/release writers all answer. Two default tools fail closed on a fresh checkout rather than answering: facts_lookup raises FactStoreUnavailable until a knowledge store exists, and orient requires an enforced exact-authority policy. The remaining writers refuse by contract until their preconditions hold rather than because the profile is unsupported: complete requires the declared artifact in Git's index, verdict refuses a same-lane pass, and request_audit refuses T2/T1 rows that self-verify. The strict deployment profile's board-backed reads fail closed by design.

features.name: Bounded context, facts, and full-text retrieval
features.notes: A fresh generic coord.db serves the capsule, digest, skeleton, focus, search, and curation lenses of python -m coordharness.coord.board_context directly. Under the strict deployment profile the same lenses fail closed with ExactQueryCoreError('exact-authority policy is not enforced and active'). Knowledge indexing and accepted-memory bootstrap remain library workflows: no MCP read creates .coordharness/knowledge.db.

features.name: Source-bound dependency and evidence graph views
